action_summary: Instant learning is recall, not generation -- measured at the boundary. Beyond the stated-command repair: eight different counting questions about one file all returned VERIFIED_ACTION carrying the same number 28, and 'count the lines in README.md' returned 51684 for a 223-line file. A row could not say WHICH ENTITIES it can count, so a correct answer to a different question was certified as an answer to this one. entity_contradiction now refuses that; the expressibility baseline falls 15 -> 14 because the 15th was a false pass.
